study: Peta, Surface Wettability Modeling and Predicting via Artificial Neural Networks
scope: EDM-textured surfaces in one controlled manufacturing setting
input_features: EDM process variables and measured surface-topography parameters
model_or_physics: Artificial neural networks with architecture and activation comparisons
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Shows strong same-process prediction but does not test publication-disjoint transfer across heterogeneous materials and protocols.

study: Fu et al., Wettability prediction and feature importance analysis for laser-chemical induced superwetting surface based on machine learning
input_features: Micro/nanoscale morphology and molecular-scale surface-chemistry descriptors
validation_reported: Study-specific training and validation including newly prepared surfaces
reported_performance: Validation RMSE 6.55 degrees; MAE 4.61 degrees; R2 0.99
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Demonstrates the value of direct morphology and chemistry descriptors in a controlled fabrication domain; such descriptors are largely missing from cross-publication records.

study: Sena et al., A Machine Learning Model for the Prediction of Water Contact Angles on Solid Polymers
scope: Water contact angle for 23 polymers and 3 copolymers
input_features: Experimental surface energy and roughness plus molecular descriptors and computed solvation free energy
model_or_physics: XGBoost with gain and SHAP analyses
reported_performance: MAE below 5 degrees; reported fits R2 0.82-0.86
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Broadens polymer chemistry coverage but predicts one liquid in a compact curated domain rather than masked multi-liquid transfer across sources.

study: Shaw et al., Accurate and Robust Static Hydrophobic Contact Angle Measurements Using Machine Learning
scope: Automated measurement from hydrophobic droplet images
input_features: Synthetic Young-Laplace half-drop contours including roughness, gravity, scale and reflections
reported_performance: Estimated error about 1 degree for angles above 110 degrees
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Addresses image-based angle measurement rather than material-to-liquid contact-angle prediction; it illustrates how controlled synthetic physics can yield much lower errors.

study: Pan et al., Machine learning-based shale wettability prediction: Implications for H2, CH4 and CO2 geo-storage
input_features: Mineralogy, total organic carbon, gas type, pressure, temperature and brine ionic strength
validation_reported: Random train-test ratios within a domain-specific collection
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: High accuracy is tied to a reservoir-specific feature space and random within-domain splitting; it is not directly comparable with source-disjoint functional-surface transfer.

study: Mwakipunda et al., Improving wettability estimation in carbonate formation using machine learning algorithms
scope: Carbonate formations for underground hydrogen storage
input_features: Pressure, temperature, salinity and formation grouping
model_or_physics: Extreme Learning Machine-Mixed Effects Random Forest compared with XGBoost and Random Forest
reported_performance: ELM-MERF reported as the best comparator
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: The mixed-effects design explicitly addresses grouped reservoir data, but its carbonate-only variables and evaluation protocol differ from target-masked cross-material prediction.

study: Roosta et al., Estimating advancing and receding contact angles for pure and mixed liquids on smooth solid surfaces using the PCP-SAFT equation of state
scope: Smooth solids with pure and mixed liquids
input_features: Liquid thermodynamic properties and fitted solid-liquid weighting parameter
reported_performance: AARD 7.4% advancing and 10.6% receding before minor parameter optimization
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Provides a recent interpretable physical alternative for smooth surfaces, while the present work uses OWRK as a nonnegative probe-derived anchor.

study: Pan et al., Robust measurement of surface tension and contact angle using physics-informed autoencoders
scope: Pendant and sessile drop image analysis
input_features: Droplet profiles constrained by the Young-Laplace equation
reported_performance: Surface-tension error below 0.2 mN/m for the reported water test
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Shows a stronger form of equation-constrained learning for measurement extraction; it does not solve cross-material contact-angle prediction from sparse literature metadata.

study: Otchere et al., A Novel Empirical and Deep Ensemble Super Learning Approach in Predicting Reservoir Wettability via Well Logs
scope: Reservoir wettability inferred from well-log variables
input_features: Petrophysical well-log descriptors and an empirical wettability index
reported_performance: Study reports improved performance after adding the empirical index
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Illustrates physics/empirical feature construction for a specific reservoir task; its target definition and data hierarchy differ from direct contact-angle regression.

study: Song et al., Development of ensemble learning techniques and sequential model-based optimization for enhancing the generalizability of shale wettability predictions
scope: Shale/mineral-alkane-water contact angles under reservoir conditions
model_or_physics: XGBoost and other learners with SHAP and sequential optimization
validation_reported: Literature plus newly measured domain-specific observations
reported_performance: XGBoost R2 reported as 0.913 in the indexed study summary
relevance_and_limit_for_current_study: Explicitly targets shale-model generalizability but remains within a reservoir domain and does not establish publication-disjoint transfer across unrelated functional surfaces.
